import { readFileSync, writeFileSync } from "node:fs";
import { createHash } from "node:crypto";
import { Buffer } from "node:buffer";
import { openNats } from "../tests/provider/nats.ts";
import { close } from "../src/close.ts";

// Candidate-independent literal NATS producer. The production client/parser is
// never imported. Only six-byte records are captured; no CONNECT secret packet
// is retained. Transport and SDK lifecycle remain owned by reviewed fixture.
const fixture = await openNats(new Uint8Array(readFileSync(".tmp/nats-wheel.whl"))), original = new Uint8Array([0, 255, 13, 10, 128, 9]);
const encode = (value: string) => new TextEncoder().encode(value);
const capture = (bytes: Uint8Array) => ({ bytes: bytes.length, base64: Buffer.from(bytes).toString("base64"), sha256: createHash("sha256").update(bytes).digest("hex") });
function same(actual: Uint8Array, expected: Uint8Array): void {
  if (actual.length !== expected.length || actual.some((value, index) => value !== expected[index])) throw new Error("Independent native NATS full-byte oracle differs.");
}
function wait<T>(promise: Promise<T>, signal: AbortSignal): Promise<T> {
  if (signal.aborted) { promise.catch(() => {}); return Promise.reject(signal.reason); }
  return new Promise<T>((resolve, reject) => {
    const abort = () => reject(signal.reason);
    signal.addEventListener("abort", abort, { once: true });
    promise.then(resolve, reject).finally(() => signal.removeEventListener("abort", abort));
  });
}
async function request(inbox: string, operation: Uint8Array) {
  const signal = AbortSignal.timeout(30000), channel = await fixture.openChannel({ signal });
  let reader: ReadableStreamDefaultReader<Uint8Array> | undefined, writer: WritableStreamDefaultWriter<Uint8Array> | undefined;
  const failures: unknown[] = [];
  let pending = new Uint8Array(), at = 0;
  try {
    reader = channel.readable.getReader(); writer = channel.writable.getWriter();
    async function take(size: number): Promise<Uint8Array<ArrayBuffer>> {
      signal.throwIfAborted();
      if (!Number.isSafeInteger(size) || size < 0 || size > 16384) throw new Error("Capture extent exceeds selected six-byte fixture.");
      const bytes = new Uint8Array(size); let position = 0, empty = 0;
      while (position < size) {
        signal.throwIfAborted();
        if (at === pending.length) {
          const next = await wait(reader!.read(), signal); signal.throwIfAborted();
          if (next.done) throw new Error("Native capture ended early.");
          const chunk = next.value; signal.throwIfAborted();
          if (chunk.length > 65536) throw new Error("Native capture chunk exceeds policy.");
          if (!chunk.length) { if (++empty > 16) throw new Error("Capture made no byte progress."); continue; }
          empty = 0; pending = new Uint8Array(chunk); at = 0;
        }
        const count = Math.min(size - position, pending.length - at);
        bytes.set(pending.subarray(at, at + count), position); position += count; at += count;
      }
      return bytes;
    }
    async function line(): Promise<Uint8Array<ArrayBuffer>> {
      const values: number[] = [];
      while (values.length < 8192) {
        const byte = (await take(1))[0]!; values.push(byte);
        if (byte === 13) { const lf = (await take(1))[0]!; if (lf !== 10) throw new Error("Capture CRLF differs."); values.push(lf); return new Uint8Array(values); }
        if (byte === 10) throw new Error("Capture bare LF.");
      }
      throw new Error("Native capture line exceeds policy.");
    }
    const initial = await line();
    if (!new TextDecoder().decode(initial).startsWith("INFO ")) throw new Error("Capture lacks native INFO.");
    signal.throwIfAborted();
    await wait(writer.write(encode('CONNECT {"verbose":false,"pedantic":true,"protocol":1,"headers":true,"no_responders":true,"lang":"capture","version":"1","tls_required":false,"user":"opfs","pass":"fixture-only-nats"}\r\nPING\r\n')), signal);
    const authControls: { response: ReturnType<typeof capture>; command?: ReturnType<typeof capture> }[] = [];
    let pong: Uint8Array | undefined;
    for (let count = 0; count <= 32; count++) {
      const frame = await line(), text = new TextDecoder().decode(frame);
      if (text === "PONG\r\n") { pong = frame; break; }
      if (count === 32) throw new Error("Native capture auth control count exceeds policy.");
      if (text.startsWith("INFO ")) authControls.push({ response: capture(frame) });
      else if (text === "PING\r\n") {
        const command = encode("PONG\r\n"); signal.throwIfAborted();
        await wait(writer.write(command), signal); signal.throwIfAborted();
        authControls.push({ response: capture(frame), command: capture(command) });
      } else throw new Error("Native capture auth barrier differs.", { cause: { header: capture(frame) } });
    }
    if (!pong) throw new Error("Native capture lacks authentication PONG.");
    const subscription = encode(`SUB ${inbox} 1\r\nUNSUB 1 1\r\n`);
    signal.throwIfAborted(); await wait(writer.write(subscription), signal); signal.throwIfAborted(); await wait(writer.write(operation), signal);
    const controls: { response: ReturnType<typeof capture>; command?: ReturnType<typeof capture> }[] = [];
    const frames: Uint8Array[] = [];
    let header: Uint8Array = new Uint8Array(), match: RegExpExecArray | null = null;
    for (let count = 0; count <= 32; count++) {
      header = await line(); const text = new TextDecoder().decode(header); frames.push(header);
      if (text.startsWith("INFO ") || text === "PING\r\n" || text === "PONG\r\n") {
        if (count === 32) throw new Error("Native capture control count exceeds policy.");
        if (text === "PING\r\n") {
          const command = encode("PONG\r\n"); signal.throwIfAborted();
          await wait(writer.write(command), signal); signal.throwIfAborted();
          controls.push({ response: capture(header), command: capture(command) });
        } else controls.push({ response: capture(header) });
        continue;
      }
      match = /^MSG ([!-~]+) 1 ([0-9]{1,5})\r\n$/.exec(text);
      if (!match || match[1] !== inbox) throw new Error("Capture reply identity differs.", { cause: { header: capture(header) } });
      break;
    }
    if (!match) throw new Error("Native capture lacks attributed MSG.");
    const body = await take(Number(match[2])), ending = await take(2); same(ending, encode("\r\n"));
    const response = new Uint8Array(header.length + body.length + ending.length);
    response.set(header); response.set(body, header.length); response.set(ending, header.length + body.length);
    frames.push(body, ending);
    const wire = new Uint8Array(frames.reduce((size, frame) => size + frame.length, 0));
    let offset = 0; for (const frame of frames) { wire.set(frame, offset); offset += frame.length; }
    return { initial: capture(initial), authControls, pong: capture(pong), subscription: capture(subscription), request: capture(operation), controls, replyWire: capture(wire), response: capture(response), body: capture(body) };
  } catch (reason) { failures.push(reason); throw reason; }
  finally { await close([() => channel.close(), () => reader?.releaseLock(), () => writer?.releaseLock()], failures); }
}
const failures: unknown[] = [];
try {
  const sequence = await fixture.seed(original); same(await fixture.read(sequence), original);
  const getInbox = "_INBOX.capture.get", getBody = encode(`{"seq":${sequence}}`);
  const get = await request(getInbox, encode(`PUB $JS.API.STREAM.MSG.GET.OWNED ${getInbox} ${getBody.length}\r\n${new TextDecoder().decode(getBody)}\r\n`));
  const value = JSON.parse(Buffer.from(get.body.base64, "base64").toString("utf8"));
  if (String(value.message.seq) !== sequence || value.message.subject !== "owned.data") throw new Error("Native stored identity differs.");
  same(new Uint8Array(Buffer.from(value.message.data, "base64")), original);
  const pubInbox = "_INBOX.capture.publish", headers = encode("NATS/1.0\r\nNats-Expected-Stream: OWNED\r\nNats-Msg-Id: independent-capture\r\n\r\n");
  const prefix = encode(`HPUB owned.data ${pubInbox} ${headers.length} ${headers.length + original.length}\r\n`), packet = new Uint8Array(prefix.length + headers.length + original.length + 2);
  packet.set(prefix); packet.set(headers, prefix.length); packet.set(original, prefix.length + headers.length); packet.set([13, 10], packet.length - 2);
  const publish = await request(pubInbox, packet), ack = JSON.parse(Buffer.from(publish.body.base64, "base64").toString("utf8"));
  if (ack.stream !== "OWNED" || !Number.isSafeInteger(ack.seq) || ack.seq < 1) throw new Error("Native publish identity differs.");
  same(await fixture.read(String(ack.seq)), original);
  const result = { profile: "Candidate-independent native NATS JetStream sequence-get and expected-stream publication", stream: "OWNED", sequence, getInbox, publishInbox: pubInbox, oracle: capture(original), get, publish };
  writeFileSync(".tmp/nats-captured.json", JSON.stringify(result, null, 2) + "\n");
  console.log(JSON.stringify({ nativeCapture: ".tmp/nats-captured.json", oracle: result.oracle, getBytes: get.response.bytes, publishBytes: publish.response.bytes }));
} catch (reason) { failures.push(reason); throw reason; }
finally { await close([() => fixture.close()], failures); }
